theme: fisherman following a school by reading currents
title: The School and the Current — finger-index drift-law recovery
strategies: trivial: freeze a constant guess at the last training fix (reproduces the checker's own frozen-finger baseline ~0.1)

greedy: ordinary least-squares straight line y=a+b*t over the raw training days, ignoring the seasonal eddy and the rip-current growth term entirely; tracks the recent average drift decently on the near days but the fixed slope under/overshoots as the cubic term takes over deeper into the graded window -> the finger falls badly behind on the harder, longer-horizon test cases

strong: two-stage decomposition -- grid-search the eddy period, fit (offset, linear drift, cubic growth, sin/cos eddy) jointly per candidate period via a 5x5 normal-equations solve in NORMALIZED time u=t/T_train, keep the period minimising training residual; the resulting smooth law both tracks the true position closely AND changes prediction gradually, so the hysteresis-band finger relocates close to the free budget instead of paying repeated $50 fees

headroom above strong: robustly down-weight training outliers, jointly refine period/phase via local search instead of a fixed grid, or model the small residual sensor-noise floor explicitly to shave the last bit of held-out distance error
